title: Blender file dialog unexpectedly hides project folders
body:
### Tested versions

4.3 stable and current master (c3ae6aa10b, 4.5-dev?)

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (c3ae6aa10) - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

I expected hidden folders to just be those prefixed with a `.`, but it also includes project folders. In my case, at some point I had accidentally extracted a project zip into my Downloads folder instead of a subfolder, and this meant my Downloads folder, where Blender was located, was mysteriously absent from my folder list.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/432a5113-1ff4-4174-8bec-acb2a22676fa)

I realize this probably rarely has any negative impact and can be worked around by showing hidden files, but I think it's pretty surprising that project folders are for some reason considered hidden and it took me a few minutes to realize that's what was occurring. 

### Steps to reproduce

Add a project.godot file (can be empty) to a directory, then attempt to set FileSystem > Import > Blender > Blender Path by opening a file. 

Navigate to the parent directory of the directory with the project file. Note that it does not appear unless the visibility of hidden files is toggled.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

None needed, but here's [MRP from another issue that has a .blend file so it asks on startup](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/15372090/subresource_bug.zip)
